description: ADTS at 11025 Hz of six channel pairs followed by SBR payloads whose header (start frequency 14, stop frequency 0, scale 3, crossover band 2) names a crossover band beyond the two bands of the master table at 22050 Hz: the tables cannot be built, the payloads are not read, and the stream is HE-AAC from the payloads' presence.
findings: bs_xover_band 2 lies beyond the 2 bands of the master frequency table
6 of 6 raw data blocks hold SBR data: the stream is HE-AAC

skip.faad: faad -i prints twice the rate of any ADTS stream at 24 kHz or less, whatever its frames hold.
skip.decode: ffmpeg rejects the header's tables and decodes the core only, as the analyzer does.
